author: Copilot
body: LegacyNumpyRandom.randint now always forces dtype=np.int64 via a lambda. That can violate the class comment about preserving the historical RandomState bitstream for int32-range draws on Windows (it changes the dtype path even when not needed), and it will also raise TypeError if any caller passes dtype in **k (duplicate keyword). Consider implementing randint as a real method that only sets dtype when required (bounds exceed int32) and that respects a caller-provided dtype.
